author: lead; user approved primary metric 2026-11-16 (±10 sessions minus random placement)

sample.split: dev only (already consumed; not a holdout)
sample.asof_plan: legacy research.features.lppls_scan index-group dev plan: every 5th session of the frozen calendar, last asof <= 2018-12-31; expected 4236 symbol-asofs (must equal #50 count, else stop and report)

fit_budget.eligibility: window length <= available bars at asof and legacy MAX_GAP_SHARE rule; eligibility fixed from calendar/history before fitting
fit_budget.solver: T01 future-only tcgrid_lm, n_random=10, seed 0, one attempt per window, no retries
fit_budget.numerical_failure: recorded as attempt status, window unresolved; never dropped
fit_budget.qualified: T01 primary filter: g_fco_standard + tc>t2 + cycles_full>=1.5

arms.B0: or4_full rule of #50 on B0 fits: alarm if any of 4 scales has qualified/eligible >= 0.05 (scale status ok, >=3 eligible); interval = 20%/80% quantiles of ahead=tc-t2 over qualified fits of all 4 scales
arms.W1: identical to B0 but windows = window_clusters.selected_windows('thin') (7 per scale, 28 total, np.rint linspace indices); fits byte-identical subset of B0
arms.C1: cluster_cross_full rule of #50 on B0 fits: fixed-width <=10 bar dense cluster, >=3 windows, >=2 scales with support fraction >=0.05, weight 1/(4*M_s), rank (mass desc, scales desc, members desc, width asc, lo asc); interval = primary cluster lo/hi
arms.calendar_fixed_10: non-LPPL reference: sessions 5-14 after action on every planned asof
arms.interval_to_sessions: l = asof_pos + floor(lo), r = asof_pos + ceil(hi); hypothetical publish 17:00 Asia/Shanghai on asof, action = next session; no trimming
arms.episodes: T02 rules: first claim fixed, revisions never rescue, new episode only after expiry

metrics.unit: mature stage events in deployment scope (first planned asof + 63 sessions .. 2018-12-31), identical E for all arms; data failures stay in E with hit=0
metrics.first_claim: first claim (any width/lead) of the episode associated with the event under T02 next-same-scope-event-within-H=63 matching
metrics.hit_k: event_lead >= 1 and distance(event_session, [l,r]) <= k (0 if inside)
metrics.random_expectation_k: for the same first claim: action A and width w fixed, start uniform over integers [A+1, max(A+1, A+63-w+1)]; r_k = P(hit_k); events without claim: r_k = 0
metrics.primary: S10 = mean over E of (hit_10 - r_10)
tables: paired_budget_scores: same asset/asof joint opportunity diagnostic, separate ledger, not deployable

statistics.also_reported: S10 per arm vs 0 (better than random placement?)
statistics.resampling: paired block bootstrap, block = calendar year of event peak date shared across assets, 10000 resamples, seed 20261116, percentile CI
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni over 2 primary comparisons: 97.5% two-sided CI
statistics.cost_tolerance: notifications_per_asset_year and alert_occupied_sessions each <= 1.25 x B0

outcome_rule.IMPROVED_DEV_ONLY: delta >= 0.05 and CI lower > 0 and cost within tolerance
outcome_rule.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: fewer than 30 evaluable mature stage events or CI width > 0.20

statistics.power_note: with ~90 stage events the expected CI half-width is ~0.08-0.10, so the 0.05 gain may be undetectable; this is accepted and reported as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE/NO_CLEAR_GAIN, never tuned

execution.pilot: sh000300 asofs in 2015 only, separate run id, engineering + timing check only, no effect comparison read
execution.full_run: single run after pilot; no re-runs to change results; corrections appended as new run/attempt ids
execution.compute: GitHub Actions research workflow (workflow_dispatch, contents read, artifacts only)

D1_T07a.windows: same 95-window B0 grid and eligibility; one representative per window = min SSE among numerically valid attempts; then T01 filter
D1_T07a.counts: Q=qualified, R=rejected, U=unresolved (numerical failure/missing/pending), N=not eligible; Q+R+U = eligible
D1_T07a.ratio_full: Q/(Q+R+U), non-null only if U=0; ratio_conditional = Q/(Q+R) named separately; per scale and pooled
